messages:
Alex (AE): quick sync — enterprise fintech wants a 2-week POC for a doc-assistant + extractive summarization in their VPC. They asked for: success criteria, sample prompts/evals, and an infra + cost ballpark. POC dates they proposed: May 12–26. Constraints: no PHI leaving the VPC, customer-managed keys, and SLA-like availability during biz hrs. Can we list: (1) clear pass/fail success criteria, (2) minimal prompt/eval set to monitor quality, (3) capacity sizing (gpu/hours) + cost estimate to fit their internal budget (~ <$4k/week if possible). I can coordinate.

Maria (Solutions): noted. For success criteria i'd propose: 1) intent detection accuracy >= 90% on 200 sample queries; 2) extractive summary ROUGE-L delta <= -5 pts vs baseline for top-3 doc types; 3) 95th pct response latency < 800ms for interactive flows during business hours. Those are measurable and tight but achievable for POC.

Maria (Solutions): sample evals: - 200 representative prompts (mix search, summarize, QA) split 70/30 train/eval; - automated scoring harness: exact-match + fuzzy match + human spot checks (10% of responses). Prompts: short list in thread: 
```
# summarization
"Summarize the following contract clause in plain English (max 3 bullets): <doc-snippet>"
# extraction
"List the named parties and the effective date from: <doc-snippet>"
# conversational
"Help me find the clause about termination in these docs" + context window
```

Ryan (Infra): infra/capacity notes — important to separate peak concurrency vs sustained throughput. Customer asked for peak 30 RPS during demos, but expected sustained average ~6 RPS. Work through both. Quick sizing options: 
- Low-latency interactive: 2x H100 (or H100-equivalent Dedicated) to keep 95th <800ms at peak with model ~7B-13B FP16/4bit.
- Cost-balanced: 1x A100-80GB with aggressive batching + prefix cache for sustained 6 RPS.

Ryan (Infra): rough cost math (illustrative): assume per-token cost is driven by GPU runtime. Example: peak 30 RPS, avg tokens/request = 1,050 (350 in + 700 out).
Calculations: 
```
tokens_per_sec_peak = 30 * 1050 = 31,500 tokens/sec
tokens_per_hour_peak = 31,500 * 3600 = 113,400,000 tokens/hr
```
If our Dedicated SKU price (incl infra amortized + sw) is ~$6.50/hr for a test A100 share (conservative) that's not the right unit — better to estimate GPU hours needed to handle peak with headroom. For 2x H100 at $12/hr each (example), 24 GPU-hrs/day -> ~ $288/day = $2k/week. Add ops/console + networking ~ +40% => ~ $2.8k/week. That fits target if we squeeze to 1 H100 for off-peak and burst to 2 H100 during demos.

Ryan (Infra): alternative: Hosted path (no private infra) would be cheaper up-front but fails the VPC/KMS constraint. So we'll need Private deployment or Dedicated in their VPC with customer-managed keys.

Sam (CSE): for the POC narrative: recommended success gating for the customer-facing stakeholders: 1) 100 sample tasks done by their SMEs with satisfaction >= 4/5; 2) no data exfil incidents; 3) runbook for cutover if we hit perf regressions. Also document expected demo script (10–12 queries showing latency & quality).

Alex (AE): good. Can you both produce: (A) 1‑page runbook I can send the customer that lists the success criteria, required artifacts from them (sample docs, SME availability, network peering window), and the estimated infra plan with cost ranges; (B) a minimal eval set (200 prompts) we can hand to them to annotate? I can loop legal for KMS wording after that.

Maria (Solutions): i'll build the eval set template and runbook draft. Deliver by EOD tomorrow. Will flag a smaller "fast-check" 40-prompt deck they can use for the first day.

Ryan (Infra): I'll put together two deployment options with hour-by-hour GPU scaling plan and a cost band (conservative / optimized). ETA tomorrow morning. Also need customer's expected max sequence length (we assumed 1,050 tokens total) — that number changes GPU memory and throughput.

Sam (CSE): security question to pre-scan: do they require HSM-backed key rotations? Also: audit logs retention length (90/365 days?) — we need this to size storage and compliance add-ons.

security-bot: SOC2 & encryption docs: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2 (internal) — ping @Alex (AE) for access request if needed. :shield:

Alex (AE): thanks — i'll ask customer to confirm: (a) max sequence length, (b) their budget flexibility (they said <$4k/week target), (c) SME time for evaluation. If they require HSM/KMS + 365d audit retention we should assume +30% cost. I'll post customer replies into this thread.

Maria (Solutions): one caution: QA for summarization needs a small human review loop in POC to avoid false positives; include instructions for sampling 10% and criteria checklist.

Ryan (Infra): note for the runbook: include fallback policy — if Dedicated capacity saturated, route to smaller quantized model (e.g., 7B q4) with graceful degradation and annotated response tag ("inference_fallback: true"). That reduces infra needs during unexpected load.

Alex (AE): perfect. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth. I’ll update when customer confirms sequences + budget. :white_check_mark:
